summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou, accompanied by their tech support Leapton, arrive at the Herb Garden to scout for a data theft mission. They encounter unexpected complications when a film crew for the show 'Approaching Science' occupies the main entrance. To avoid being caught on camera, Gu Suizhou drags Shen Feizhi off a cliff, aiming for a cave twenty meters below. Shen Feizhi, displaying superior physical control, maneuvers them to land safely in the cave, despite Gu Suizhou's constant flirtatious behavior and attempts to act as a 'meat cushion'.
